description:
You are an e-commerce content manager reorganizing the product catalog for better navigation and discoverability.

1. Create a parent product category called 'Outdoor & Recreation'. Under it, create two subcategories: 'Camping Gear' and 'Fitness Equipment'. Both subcategories must have 'Outdoor & Recreation' as their parent category.
2. Reassign products to the new subcategories:
   - Move 'Portable Camping Hammock' into the 'Camping Gear' subcategory.
   - Move 'Yoga Mat Premium' and 'Resistance Band Set' into the 'Fitness Equipment' subcategory.
   (The products should appear under the new subcategories. They may also remain in their original categories.)
3. Create these product tags: 'bestseller', 'eco-friendly', and 'gift-idea'. Assign them as follows:
   - 'bestseller' tag: Wireless Bluetooth Headphones and Yoga Mat Premium
   - 'eco-friendly' tag: Organic Cotton T-Shirt and Bamboo Cutting Board Set
   - 'gift-idea' tag: LED Desk Lamp and Ceramic Plant Pot Set
4. Mark these two products as 'Featured': Wireless Bluetooth Headphones and Yoga Mat Premium.
5. Update the short description of 'Portable Camping Hammock' to exactly: 'Ultralight double hammock perfect for backpacking and outdoor adventures. Supports up to 500 lbs.'
6. Save all changes.

short_description_update.text: Ultralight double hammock perfect for backpacking and outdoor adventures. Supports up to 500 lbs.
